_comment: Each experiment inherits the base settings and changes only the listed arguments. Use python run_experiment.py <name> to print a command, add --seed N for one seed or --all-seeds for every seed below, and --execute to run.
_base_comment: Settings for one 8 GB GPU. Sizes are height,width. Every run trains for the full number of epochs and validates after each one.

baseline.description: Fine-tuned three-channel Depth Anything V2 baseline.

pitchdepth.description: Four-channel PitchDepth: RGB plus the fixed ground prior.

pitchdepth_silog.description: PitchDepth trained with SILog instead of the trimmed scale-and-shift-invariant loss.

baseline_silog.description: Three-channel baseline trained with SILog for a matched loss ablation.

prior_norm_minmax.description: Prior normalisation experiment: map the prior to [0,1] instead of standardising.

prior_norm_none.description: Prior normalisation experiment: feed the raw averaged prior with no normalisation.

prior_scale_half.description: Prior weighting experiment: down-weight the prior channel (scale 0.5).

prior_scale_double.description: Prior weighting experiment: up-weight the prior channel (scale 2.0).

prior_init_avg.description: Patch-embed init experiment: initialise the 4th conv channel with the mean of the RGB weights instead of zero.

constant_schedule.description: Schedule experiment: constant learning rate instead of polynomial decay.

cosine_schedule.description: Schedule experiment: cosine decay with warm-up instead of polynomial decay.
